summary: Defines SNMP management objects for IEEE 802.3 Medium Attachment Units, covering 10 and 100 Mb/s Ethernet. Network managers can use it to inspect and configure those interfaces. It was replaced by RFC 2668.

eli5.summary: It gives managers a standard way to check the wired connection on an Ethernet device and see how fast it is running.

questions: how to manage ethernet mau with snmp
